yearOneTimeline.description: Tanzania Health Alliance officially launched to combat Hepatitis, HIV, and Mental Health challenges
THA's innovative approach to hepatitis response featured in World Health Organization documentary
Gained official membership with World Hepatitis Alliance, expanding global network
Founder Shaibu Issa elected to World Hepatitis Alliance Board—representing Tanzania's voice globally
Major donor partnerships secured, enabling expansion of all three campaigns
Strategic partnership with Tanzania's Ministry of Health to scale health interventions nationally

globalRecognition.whoDocumentary: Featured in World Health Organization hepatitis response documentary
globalRecognition.whaBoard: Founder Shaibu Issa serves on World Hepatitis Alliance Board
globalRecognition.whaMembers: Official World Hepatitis Alliance member organization

governmentPartnership.headline: Formally Recognized at the National Level
governmentPartnership.description: In March 2026, THA formalized a strategic partnership with Tanzania's Ministry of Health, marking a historic commitment to scaling health interventions across the country.
governmentPartnership.permanentSecretaryQuote: We are proud to partner with Tanzania Health Alliance in our mission to strengthen healthcare systems and improve health outcomes for all Tanzanians. Their work in hepatitis, HIV, and mental health aligns perfectly with our national health priorities.
governmentPartnership.permanentSecretaryTitle: Permanent Secretary, Ministry of Health, Tanzania
whatItMeans: National-level recognition and alignment with Tanzania's health priorities
Access to public health facilities for testing and screening
Integration of THA programs into national health strategy
Pathway to scale across all regions of Tanzania
governmentPartnership.impact: This partnership ensures THA's programs are not just community-led but also nationally recognized, creating sustainable, nationwide health infrastructure improvement.

whoDocumentary.title: Featured in WHO Hepatitis Response Documentary
whoDocumentary.description: THA's innovative approach to hepatitis awareness and prevention was highlighted in a World Health Organization documentary showcasing effective global responses to viral hepatitis.
whoDocumentary.relevance: Recognition from WHO validates THA's evidence-based approach and positions Tanzania as a leader in hepatitis response in East Africa.

whaBoard.title: Founder Elected to World Hepatitis Alliance Board
whaBoard.description: Shaibu Issa's election to the WHA Board (November 2025) gives Tanzania a voice in global hepatitis policy and strategy.
whaBoard.relevance: This positions THA at the forefront of the global health movement and enables direct influence on international hepatitis initiatives.

whaMemembership.title: World Hepatitis Alliance Membership
whaMemembership.description: Official membership in the World Hepatitis Alliance connects THA to a global network of 800+ organizations working on viral hepatitis.
whaMemembership.relevance: Access to global best practices, research, and collaborative opportunities.
